_about: Cameras and arm kinematic offsets of the real YAM rig (duchamp3), calibrated 2026-10-25. Sim counterpart: Menagerie yam_linear_4310.xml 'wrist_cam' (a RealSense D405); EnvCfg.cam_spec replaces its field of view and mount pose with wrist.sim (the right, policy-arm camera). The real wrist cameras are RGB only. Device paths: scripts/real/rig.py.

wrist.model: generic UVC webcam (Generic 'USB Camera', iSerial 'YHTek'; Realtek chip, USB 0bda:5883)
wrist._serial_note: both cameras report the same iSerial 'YHTek', so they are told apart by USB port only

sim._about: Read by EnvCfg.cam_spec (blind_insertion/assets/real_camera.py). Values of the RIGHT wrist camera (the policy arm). The policy image on both sides: undistort with the intrinsics, crop the largest square centred on the principal point (policy_crop_px), resize to cam_res; the sim renders a square at fovy_deg from pose_in_link6, so no principal-point offset is needed.
sim._pose_note: camera optical frame (OpenCV: +z along the optical axis, +y down) in the Menagerie YAM link_6 frame; {pos: [m], quat: [w, x, y, z]}. Valid with the right arm's joint offsets applied to its joint readings (spec 'arms').

wrist._calib_note: per arm, scripts/real/calib.py: intrinsics from hand-held frames over the whole image plus the arm's views (5-coefficient OpenCV model [k1, k2, p1, p2, k3], 1280x1024 pixels); pose by hand-eye on the Menagerie link_6 frame with the arm's joint offsets (spec 'arms') applied. The two webcams have different lenses.

top.usb: USB 3 (5 Gbps) required for the SDK
top._intrinsics_note: factory calibration from the ZED SDK 5.2, rectified images (distortion removed); left and right identical

extrinsics_cam_in_right_base._note: ZED HD1080 rectified-left optical frame (OpenCV) in the right base, via the static board (run_004)

extrinsics_cam_in_left_base._note: ZED HD1080 rectified-left optical frame (OpenCV) in the left base, via the static board (run_003)

arms._about: Encoder zero offsets of each real arm against the Menagerie YAM kinematics (rad, joints 1-6): add them to the measured joint positions (q_model = q_measured + offset) so FK, the camera pose and the sim agree. Joints 1 and 6 are not observable by hand-eye (they trade off with the board and the camera mount) and are left at 0. Fitted 2026-10-25 with the wrist cameras; hand-eye hold-out right 8.0 -> 2.7 px, left 3.0 -> 2.2 px.
